page.title: Experiments
page.desc: Controlled price tests: a treatment delta applied to a SKU scope, measured against the demand model.

empty: No experiments yet. Create one to test a price change on a SKU scope.

builder.title: New experiment
builder.name: Name
builder.skusHint: Comma-separated SKU ids that receive the treatment price.

start.title: Start experiment
start.note: Starting applies the treatment price to every SKU immediately and records outcomes from the demand model. Cancelling ends the test; prices stay applied until changed in catalog.

result.framing: Directional signal only — {n} SKU outcomes, {days} days running. Observed values come from the demo demand model, not real traffic.

err.forbidden: You don't have permission to manage experiments.
err.guardrail: The treatment price breaches a min/max bound on at least one SKU — adjust the delta or scope.
